observerNotes.observation: Early 960x540 runs exceeded the 60s DOMContentLoaded observation on the shared software renderer. Subsequent records wait for the original phase, use the recorded smaller gameplay viewport, and still measure both full TV layouts.
The first 20s seat observation ended before the TV row was observed. A following read found seat 1 in the original title. A fresh room was opened for the completed run.
An initial comparison observed the old 640px presentation canvas before the original window resize handler ran. The signed-APK repeat waits for the actual resize event before comparing each view.
The first web assets had version 0.2.2/code 4 in game-config.json. This record uses the final 0.2.3/code 5 configuration and mobile touch input.
